rv.q: This ripping apart of Shakespeare's arguably most famous creation was a grounding adventure for me.
Still, it’s difficult to see the audience participation in Becoming Hamlet as much more than a gimmick.
But the let's-all-play-Hamlet conceit proves to be more performative than profound.
I simply found its central device more gimmick than revelation.

cn.t: This experimental Hamlet adaptation draws mixed reviews for its participatory approach—critics appreciate the innovative concept of audience involvement but find the execution uneven, with some praising its visceral storytelling while others feel the idea never fully comes togeth
